title: riordan-poset-enumeration: construction, enumeration and analysis of Riordan posets
description: Header-only C++20 library and tools for Riordan posets (posets whose order relation is a binary Riordan matrix): enumeration, canonical forms, verified counts of Riordan posets up to n = 28, recognition, Toeplitz and exponential Riordan posets, and an exact decision procedure for infinite Riordan posets. The counts of non-isomorphic (unlabelled) Riordan posets are in OEIS A379608 (terms n = 16..28 from this work) and the counts of labelled Riordan posets (Riordan poset matrices) are OEIS A400879.
